bio: I am an incoming Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the University of Central Florida, advised by Prof. Chen Chen.

My research focuses on building efficient, stable, and reliable computer vision systems. My long-term goal is to improve how computers process and understand visual information, including images and videos, and to explore computer vision applications in digital entertainment, film, and gaming.
